meanings.en: a piece or section of something
meanings.exampleEn: This is my favourite part of the book.

meanings.en: to some extent but not completely
meanings.exampleEn: The accident was partly my fault.

meanings.en: an official document allowing you to enter or use something
meanings.exampleEn: You need a pass to enter the building.
meanings.exampleTr: Binaya girmek için bir geçiş kartına ihtiyacın var.

meanings.en: a long narrow space connecting places, or a section of text
meanings.exampleEn: We walked down a dark passage to the kitchen.
meanings.exampleTr: Mutfağa giden karanlık bir koridordan yürüdük.

meanings.en: a person travelling in a vehicle but not driving it
meanings.exampleEn: The plane can carry two hundred passengers.

meanings.en: an Italian food made from flour and water
meanings.exampleEn: We had pasta with tomato sauce for dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Akşam yemeğinde domates soslu makarna yedik.

meanings.en: a narrow way for walking
meanings.exampleEn: We followed the path through the forest.
meanings.exampleTr: Ormanın içinden geçen patikayı takip ettik.

meanings.en: a personal computer
meanings.exampleEn: I bought a new PC for my office.
meanings.exampleTr: Ofisim için yeni bir bilgisayar aldım.

meanings.en: a small round green vegetable
meanings.exampleEn: She put some peas on her plate.

meanings.en: calm and quiet, without trouble
meanings.exampleEn: The village is a peaceful place to live.
meanings.exampleTr: Köy yaşamak için huzurlu bir yer.

meanings.en: a sweet juicy fruit that is narrow at the top
meanings.exampleEn: I ate a ripe pear after lunch.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğle yemeğinden sonra olgun bir armut yedim.

meanings.en: the plural of penny, a British coin
meanings.exampleEn: The newspaper costs fifty pence.

meanings.en: a person in another place you write letters to as a friend
meanings.exampleEn: I have a penfriend in Japan.

meanings.en: a vegetable or a spice used to flavour food
meanings.exampleEn: Add some salt and pepper to the soup.
meanings.exampleTr: Çorbaya biraz tuz ve karabiber ekle.

meanings.en: as good as it can possibly be
meanings.exampleEn: The weather was perfect for a picnic.

meanings.en: completely, or in a perfect way
meanings.exampleEn: The dress fits her perfectly.
meanings.exampleTr: Elbise ona mükemmel bir şekilde oturuyor.

meanings.en: to do something, or to entertain people on stage
meanings.exampleEn: The band will perform at the festival tonight.
meanings.exampleTr: Grup bu gece festivalde sahne alacak.

meanings.en: the act of performing a play, concert or other entertainment
meanings.exampleEn: The performance starts at eight o'clock.

meanings.en: a liquid with a pleasant smell that you put on your skin
meanings.exampleEn: She wears a lovely perfume.

meanings.en: used to say that something is possible
meanings.exampleEn: Perhaps we should leave early tomorrow.

meanings.en: the act of allowing someone to do something
meanings.exampleEn: You need permission to leave the classroom.

meanings.en: the qualities that make a person who they are
meanings.exampleEn: She has a friendly personality.

meanings.en: a liquid fuel used in cars
meanings.exampleEn: We need to buy some petrol before the trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Yolculuktan önce biraz benzin almamız gerekiyor.

meanings.en: a place where you can buy fuel for your car
meanings.exampleEn: There is a petrol station at the end of the road.
meanings.exampleTr: Yolun sonunda bir benzin istasyonu var.

meanings.en: a picture made with a camera
meanings.exampleEn: She showed me a photograph of her family.

meanings.en: a person who takes photographs
meanings.exampleEn: The photographer took pictures at the wedding.

meanings.en: the art or activity of taking photographs
meanings.exampleEn: Photography is my favourite hobby.

meanings.en: connected with the body rather than the mind
meanings.exampleEn: Running is good physical exercise.

meanings.en: in a way connected to the body
meanings.exampleEn: The job is physically demanding.

meanings.en: a number of things lying on top of each other
meanings.exampleEn: There is a pile of books on the desk.
meanings.exampleTr: Masanın üstünde bir yığın kitap var.

meanings.en: a person who travels to a holy place for religious reasons
meanings.exampleEn: Many pilgrims visit the city every year.
meanings.exampleTr: Her yıl birçok hacı şehri ziyaret eder.

meanings.en: a small piece of medicine that you swallow
meanings.exampleEn: Take this pill twice a day.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu hapı günde iki kez al.

meanings.en: a person who flies an aircraft
meanings.exampleEn: The pilot landed the plane safely.

meanings.en: a feeling of sadness for someone's trouble, or something disappointing
meanings.exampleEn: It is a pity that you cannot come to the party.

meanings.en: a large object in space that moves around a star
meanings.exampleEn: Mars is a planet near the Earth.

meanings.en: a living thing that grows in the ground
meanings.exampleEn: I water the plants every morning.

meanings.en: made of a light artificial material
meanings.exampleEn: She drank from a plastic cup.

meanings.en: a flat dish for serving or eating food
meanings.exampleEn: He put the food on a clean plate.

meanings.en: full of fun and wanting to play
meanings.exampleEn: The puppy is very playful.

meanings.en: an outdoor area where children can play
meanings.exampleEn: The children are playing in the playground.

meanings.en: enjoyable or nice
meanings.exampleEn: We had a pleasant evening together.

meanings.en: happy or satisfied about something
meanings.exampleEn: I am very pleased with my exam results.

meanings.en: giving pleasure or satisfaction
meanings.exampleEn: The garden has a pleasing design.
meanings.exampleTr: Bahçenin hoşa giden bir tasarımı var.

meanings.en: a large amount, enough or more than enough
meanings.exampleEn: There is plenty of food for everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkese yetecek kadar bol yemek var.

meanings.en: the form of a word used for more than one
meanings.exampleEn: The plural of 'child' is 'children'.

meanings.en: the official organization that keeps order and catches criminals
meanings.exampleEn: The police arrived at the scene quickly.

meanings.en: a member of the police
meanings.exampleEn: A police officer helped us find the address.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir polis memuru adresi bulmamıza yardım etti.

meanings.en: the office of a local police force
meanings.exampleEn: He reported the theft at the police station.

meanings.en: a male member of the police
meanings.exampleEn: A policeman directed the traffic.

meanings.en: a female member of the police
meanings.exampleEn: The policewoman asked us a few questions.
meanings.exampleTr: Kadın polis bize birkaç soru sordu.

meanings.en: connected with government or public affairs
meanings.exampleEn: They discussed many political issues.

meanings.en: to make air, water or land dirty and harmful
meanings.exampleEn: Factories often pollute the rivers.

meanings.en: liked by many people
meanings.exampleEn: This song is very popular among teenagers.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu şarkı gençler arasında çok popüler.

meanings.en: the number of people living in a place
meanings.exampleEn: The population of the city is growing fast.

meanings.en: a painting, drawing or photograph of a person
meanings.exampleEn: The artist painted a portrait of the queen.

meanings.en: the place where someone or something is
meanings.exampleEn: Please return the chair to its original position.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen sandalyeyi eski konumuna geri koy.

meanings.en: able to be done or to happen
meanings.exampleEn: It is possible to finish the work today.

meanings.en: used to say that something may be true or happen
meanings.exampleEn: She will possibly arrive late tonight.

meanings.en: a place where you can buy stamps and send letters
meanings.exampleEn: I went to the post office to send a parcel.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir koli göndermek için postaneye gittim.

meanings.en: to make a liquid flow out of a container
meanings.exampleEn: She poured some milk into the glass.

meanings.en: the ability to control people or things, or energy
meanings.exampleEn: The storm knocked out the electric power.

meanings.en: having a lot of strength or control
meanings.exampleEn: The new engine is very powerful.

meanings.en: exact and accurate
meanings.exampleEn: Please give me the precise time of the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen bana toplantının kesin saatini ver.

meanings.en: to say what will happen in the future
meanings.exampleEn: Scientists predict that it will rain tomorrow.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları yarın yağmur yağacağını tahmin ediyor.

meanings.en: a statement about what will happen in the future
meanings.exampleEn: Her prediction about the weather was correct.
meanings.exampleTr: Hava durumuyla ilgili tahmini doğru çıktı.

meanings.en: to like one thing more than another
meanings.exampleEn: I prefer tea to coffee.

meanings.en: to get something or yourself ready
meanings.exampleEn: She is preparing dinner for the guests.

meanings.en: the force of pushing on something, or a feeling of stress
meanings.exampleEn: He felt a lot of pressure before the exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Sınavdan önce üzerinde büyük bir baskı hissetti.

meanings.en: to stop something from happening
meanings.exampleEn: Wearing a seatbelt can prevent injuries.

meanings.en: a feeling of pleasure in your own or others' achievements
meanings.exampleEn: She felt great pride in her son's success.
meanings.exampleTr: Oğlunun başarısından büyük bir gurur duydu.
